Flow.description: #24396 : Opp Governance: Lock Opp Split & Opp Team in Stage 5/6/7 w/ special permissions - RITM0714831 #25042: Add bypass logic. User with Update Splits and Team members on Closed Oppty permission set/ Update_Fields_on_a_Closed_Opportunity permission set group will be bypassed

start.filterFormula: AND( NOT({!$Profile.Name} == 'IM_Custom Sys Admin'), OR(ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Opportunity.StageName}, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Opportunity.StageName}, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Opportunity.StageName}, '7 - Closed')), NOT({!$Permission.Update_Splits_and_Team_members_on_Closed_Oppty}) )
